args.label: daily-scorecard-loop
args.instruction: Run the Daily Scorecard Loop workflow: Every weekday morning, assemble yesterday's scorecard for Mike: lane metrics for LinkedIn, the GTM funnel, and site health, each measured against its target, with misses flagged and one recommended focus for the day. Read-only: it reports, it never posts, sends, or changes anything. Produce: scorecard markdown at ~/.rig/live/prime-aside-driver/jake/conductor/workflow-design-studio/runs/scorecard-<date>.md; run log line with per-metric sources and any missing inputs. Nothing outward without Gate-D.
